description: This file is a script used to detect changed file paths in a Git repository and determine the scope of various CI/CD workflows to run based on the changes. It defines functions for detecting scope, listing changed files, and writing output for GitHub Actions. The script facilitates conditional CI execution tailored to specific parts of the project.

methods.name: detectChangedScope
methods.description: Analyzes a list of changed paths to determine which CI workflows should be run based on scope-specific regex tests.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Uses git diff to list files changed between a base and a head commit or branch.

methods.name: writeGitHubOutput
methods.description: Appends the CI scope results to the GitHub Actions output file, enabling conditional workflow runs.
